_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: A project's settings: delete waits for an empty project; a moved task changes groups. The server runs in workspace mode, with the projects "From tasks", which has the task {{TASK}} ("Move me"), and "To tasks", which is empty. Call "move" moves the task to "To tasks" through the API (as the Assistant would; not the sidebar). "The task row" is ".conversation-item[data-conversation-id=\"{{TASK}}\"]"; "the group of" P is "section[aria-label=\"P\"]" and its "toggle" is its ".project-toggle". On a fresh server the first load of a page takes a few seconds while the Assistant is created (the header title reads "Shelley" until then): wait for elements rather than reading the page right after navigating. On a phone-sized screen the drawer is off-canvas until the header's "Open tasks" button is clicked. To "open the drawer": click the button named exactly "Open tasks" if it is visible (on a phone it is whenever the drawer is closed: it is the header's top-left button; the drawer's own "Close tasks" button stays in the page while the drawer is off-canvas, so it says nothing about whether the drawer is open); the element with data-testid "assistant-row" should then be visible within the viewport. To "reload": the reload action. To "open the settings of" a project P: click "section[aria-label=\"P\"] a.project-select", then, in the element with data-testid "project-view", click the button named exactly "Settings" in its navigation (its <nav> element; click it even when its tab already shows); "the editor" is the region (role "region"; a <section> with that aria-label) named exactly "Edit project". To "edit project P" with a change: eval sessionStorage.setItem("editFrom", location.pathname) to remember the page; open the drawer; open the settings of P; make the change in the editor; click the editor's button named exactly "Save project"; the editor's text "Saved." should be visible; then return to the remembered page with a full load: eval (() => { window.__leaving = 1; location.assign(sessionStorage.getItem("editFrom")); return "leaving"; })(), expecting "leaving", then eval "window.__leaving === undefined && document.readyState === 'complete'" until it returns true. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /. 2. Open the drawer. 3. The task row inside the group of "From tasks" should be visible. 4. The task row should come to hold exactly 0 ".working-indicator" elements. 5. The toggle of "From tasks" should have aria-expanded "true", and that of "To tasks" aria-expanded "false" (empty projects start folded). 6. Click the toggle of "To tasks"; it should come to have aria-expanded "true". 7. Click it again; it should come to have aria-expanded "false" (fold the empty project explicitly; its first conversation unfolds it anyway). 8. Open the settings of "From tasks". 9. The editor's button named "Delete project…" should be disabled, and the editor should contain "Archive or move its active task first" (a project with conversations can't be deleted, and its settings say why). 10. Go back (the go_back action). 11. Open the drawer. 12. Call "move". 13. The task row inside the group of "To tasks" should become visible. 14. There should be exactly 0 task rows inside the group of "From tasks". 15. The toggle of "To tasks" should have aria-expanded "true", and that of "From tasks" aria-expanded "false" (the first conversation unfolds its project; the emptied one folds). 16. Click the toggle of "From tasks"; it should come to have aria-expanded "true" (an explicit choice outlasts emptiness). 17. Click the toggle of "To tasks". 18. There should come to be exactly 0 task rows inside the group of "To tasks", and its toggle should have aria-expanded "false".

steps.text: Archive or move its active task first
